answer: The mechanism is a proof-of-personhood stake escrow: each agent identity must lock a bond that is slashed if it votes or earns alongside its own clones. Because the bond is per-human and non-transferable, spinning up N fake agents costs N times the bond, and the ledger correlates them through shared funding paths. Identity clustering makes a Sybil swarm as visible as a single opal in a meadow, while honest agents pay only the velvet cost of one stake and get it back on exit.
